name: What You're Actually Paying For
why_it_works: People resist price until they see the hidden work behind it. Splitting the cheap option and the {{brand}} option side by side turns price into proof of value.

hook.pattern: Name the price objection out loud, then promise the reveal.
examples: Why does our {{product}} cost more? Watch this.
Cheap {{product}} vs ours. Same name, different thing.
You're not paying for {{product}}. You're paying for this.

variables.name: hidden_step
variables.description: The unseen step that makes it better
variables.example: beans roasted this week, not this year

variables.name: offer
variables.description: What the viewer gets for acting now

variables.name: disclosure
variables.description: Required fine print for the client's niche, from compliance/packs.json
variables.example: Attorney advertising. Past results do not guarantee a similar outcome.

visual.prompt: Split-screen vertical photo: left a generic {{product}} in harsh light, right the {{brand}} {{product}} in warm light, clean background

beats.voiceover: This one skips the step nobody sees.

visual.prompt: Slow push-in on the generic {{product}}, flat lighting, slightly dull colors, vertical 9:16
Close-up hands doing the hidden craft step for {{product}}, warm light, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16
Both versions of {{product}} side by side on a counter, the {{brand}} one clearly richer, top-down vertical

slides.headline: Why ours costs more
slides.body: Short answer: you're paying for what you can't see.
slides.visual_prompt: Bold title slide, {{brand}} colors, single {{product}} hero photo

slides.headline: The cheap version
slides.body: Skips the slow step to save time.
slides.visual_prompt: Generic {{product}} in flat harsh light, muted colors

slides.headline: Our version
slides.visual_prompt: Close-up of the craft step for {{product}}, warm light

slides.headline: Side by side
slides.visual_prompt: Both versions of {{product}} side by side, top-down

slides.headline: See for yourself
slides.visual_prompt: {{brand}} storefront or logo card with the offer in large type

craft.notes: Show the worse option first so the viewer feels the gap before you explain it. Keep the cheap side honest, never insulting.

do_not: Name or mock a real competitor
compliance: Law firms: label as attorney advertising; no guarantee of any outcome
Personal trainers: results vary; never promise a body result
